python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from larder.cancellation import can_cancel
for name in ('docs/features/cancellation.md', 'docs/features/README.md'):
    page = Path(name)
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', page.read_text()):
        assert (page.parent / target).is_file(), (name, target)
pickup = datetime(2026, 10, 30, 17)
cutoff = pickup - timedelta(hours=2)
assert can_cancel(pickup, cutoff - timedelta(microseconds=1))
assert not can_cancel(pickup, cutoff)
assert not can_cancel(pickup, cutoff + timedelta(microseconds=1))
print('Documentation links and cutoff example verified.')
PY
